entities.name: Xander
entities.description: Vampire crime-lord and boss of the Maestros family in New Capenna, killed by Ob Nixilis.

entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: The crime family led by Xander in New Capenna, running galleries, museums and assassins for hire.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: The city-plane where Xander is a crime-lord.

entities.name: Archdemons
entities.description: Demons who offered Xander eternal life and appointed the five heads of families.

entities.name: Evelyn
entities.description: Xander's former lover and a vampire he sired.

entities.name: Anhelo
entities.description: Xander's deputy, to whom he willed control of the Maestros.

entities.name: Crescendo
entities.description: Event during which Xander was killed on New Year's night.

events.summary: Xander, an ailing artist, accepts the archdemons' gift of eternal life and unwittingly becomes a vampire.
events.quote: He was offered the gift of eternal life from the plane's archdemons

events.summary: Xander becomes one of the five family heads and signatories of the contract that created New Capenna.
events.quote: He was one of the five heads of families that were appointed by the archdemons

events.summary: Ob Nixilis kills Xander on New Year's night during the Crescendo.
events.quote: Xander was killed by Ob Nixilis

events.summary: Xander wills control of the Maestros to his deputy Anhelo.
events.quote: He willed control of the Maestros to his deputy, Anhelo .
